name: croc_coiled_underwater
description: Saltwater crocodile underwater, side view facing right: body in a shallow S, head angled slightly up toward the surface, jaws closed, legs tucked back, thick muscular tail curled back over itself, ready to push. Mid-tone olive (#868a52 hide, lighter flanks) with a 5 px black outline so it reads in murky #4f5e3a water (also works as a silhouette with a red rim). Anchor centre; bbox x -400..412, y -160..135.
